'''Marionium''' was a substance that, along with [[petonium]], was one of the main exports from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sunspot (Tython system)|Sunspot]].

{{Substance-stub}}

==Description==
Marionium was a substance with a metallic structure that was considered the most unstable element ever discovered on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sunspot (Tython system)|Sunspot]]. Along with [[petonium]], marionium was mined in the mines of the settlement [[Ran Dan's Folly]].<ref name="Into the Void" />

==History==
In [[25,793 BBY]], in one of these shafts, [[Stargazers|Stargazer]] [[Dalien Brock]] used a marionium cube to charge the [[Gree device]] with [[Dark matter/Legends|dark matter]], which when activated, he planned to launch a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Hypergate]] with in the [[Old City (Tython)|Old City]] of the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="Into the Void" />
